meta.title: Student gouge — verified
meta.source: PC-24.pdf, 11 pp, authored by another student in Derek's course
meta.note: Every value below was checked against the AFM (Report 02371, Issue 003 Rev 08) and the FSI Pilot Training Manual Appendix B. Status is per-line. The AFM is authoritative; where the gouge disagrees, the AFM value is shown as the correction.
meta.aircraft: MSN 631 — MSN 501-UP column for every serial-dependent value

sections.name: Weights — read this first
sections.warn: Every weight in the gouge is the MSN 101-500 value. Derek's aircraft is MSN 631, which is MSN 501-UP. All four are 440 lb low. This is the single biggest problem in the document.

items.label: Maximum Ramp Weight
items.correct: 18,840 lb (8,545 kg) for MSN 501-UP. 18,400 lb is the MSN 101-500 value.
items.src: AFM p97 weight table; card L-2

items.label: Maximum Takeoff Weight
items.src: AFM p97 and p96 — the AFM states the two serial ranges separately; card L-3

items.label: Maximum cargo (freight) weight
items.src: PTM App B p771; card L-4

items.label: Maximum baggage weight, large restraint net
items.src: Serial-independent. Small net is 400 lb — the gouge omits it. Card L-4

items.label: Baggage vs cargo definition
items.src: PTM App B p771 — baggage is an item with mass > 66 lb (30 kg) classed as cargo. Must be in a restraint system.

items.label: Floor loading
items.gouge: 100 lb/ft² over floor panels, 670 lb/ft on seat rails

items.label: Tail stand
items.gouge: Install tail stand before loading cargo

items.label: Approved takeoff/landing surfaces
items.gouge: Dry/wet: paved, dirt, grass, sand, gravel. Contaminated: paved
items.correct: Baseline approval is DRY AND WET PAVED runways only. Everything else needs an AFM Supplement: contaminated paved (Sup 02442), dirt/sand/gravel (Sup 02444), grass (Sup 02473) — and the gravel kit installed. Listing dirt/grass/sand/gravel as plain approved surfaces is the kind of error that matters on a limitations quiz and in dispatch.
items.src: Card L-10; PTM App B p771

items.label: Maximum operating altitude
items.gouge: 45,000 ft (implied by 'Vo sea level to FL450')
items.src: Card L-7; PTM App B p771

items.label: Maximum pressure altitude, landing field elevation
Maximum runway slope
items.src: Card L-10; PTM App B p771

items.label: Maximum tailwind, takeoff and landing
items.src: Card L-11; PTM App B p771

items.label: Minimum / maximum OAT at sea level
items.correct: Values right, labels wrong. These are MINIMUM OAT (-54 °C) and MAXIMUM OAT (+50 °C) at sea level.

items.label: Towbarless tug weight limit
items.src: PTM App B p771 — 5,379 lb (2,440 kg)

items.label: Maximum passengers
items.gouge: not stated (gouge says '11 total pax' O2 masks)
items.correct: Maximum 10 passengers. The mask count is not the passenger limit.
items.src: PTM App B p771; card L-9

items.label: Dimensions
items.correct: Span 55 ft 9 in (17 m), length 55 ft 2 in (16.8 m), height 17 ft 4 in (5.3 m). Anchor: span beats length.
items.src: Card AGI-8; PTM App B p771

items.label: Cabin door dimensions
items.gouge: 2 ft 0.4 in W × 4 ft 5.2 in H

items.label: Cargo door dimensions
items.gouge: 4 ft 1 in W × 4 ft 3 in H

items.label: Airstair capacity
items.src: PTM App B p771; card L-32

items.label: Doors with left engine running
items.gouge: Cargo door: do not open when left engine is running
items.correct: Applies to BOTH doors — cabin door AND cargo door must be closed with the left engine running. And before left engine start, passenger and cargo doors must be closed and secured.
items.src: PTM App B p771 and p776

items.label: Overwing exit security pins
items.correct: Remove and stow prior to flight.
items.src: Card L-33; PTM App B p771

items.label: Emergency exits
items.gouge: 2 over-wing plus cabin door; no CAS if an exit is opened
items.correct: Exit count is right. The 'no CAS' claim was not confirmed in the AFM or PTM — treat as unverified.

items.label: Nose gear castoring / towing angle
items.correct: 60°, reached when the red markings on either side of the NLG align.

items.label: VMO / MMO
items.correct: VMO 290 KIAS at or below 28,230 ft; MMO 0.74 M at or above 28,230 ft.
items.src: Card L-1; PTM App B p774

items.label: VLO extend
items.src: Card L-28; PTM App B p775

items.label: VLO retract
items.src: Card L-28; PTM App B p775

items.label: VLE
items.src: Card L-28; PTM App B p775

items.label: VLO extend, emergency gear (EGES)
items.correct: Two FSI sources disagree. The FSI Memory Flash Card (L-28) gives 180 KIAS as the limit with a note that QRH L/G Emergency Extension 3-NAE-13 requires 160 KIAS or less. PTM Appendix B p775 gives 160 KIAS outright. FLY 160 — it satisfies both and matches the QRH procedure. Know that 180 may be the expected answer if asked from the flash card.
items.src: Card L-28 vs PTM App B p775

items.label: VFE flaps 8° / 15°
items.correct: Confirmed. Note this is NOT on any of your 198 cards — the deck has no VFE card. Worth adding.
items.src: PTM p144 and App B p773

items.label: VFE flaps 33°
items.correct: Confirmed. Also missing from your deck.
items.src: PTM p144 and App B p773

items.label: VO (maneuvering), range
items.src: AFM p83; PTM App B p774

items.label: Rudder — up to FL200
items.correct: Do not make full or abrupt rudder movements above 130 KIAS up to 20,000 ft.

items.label: Rudder — above FL200
items.correct: Do not make full or abrupt rudder movements above 125 KIAS above 20,000 ft.

items.label: Rudder pedal travel, 1/3 limit
items.correct: Sea level to 45,000 ft: do not exceed 1/3 pedal travel above 185 KIAS.

items.label: Rudder pedal travel, 1/10 limit
items.correct: Sea level to 45,000 ft: do not exceed 1/10 pedal travel above 290 KIAS.

items.label: VMC takeoff, flaps 8° / 15°
items.correct: Correct at heavy weight only. Flaps 8°: ≥13,669 lb → 82, >12,125 → 87, >11,023 → 90. Flaps 15°: ≥13,228 lb → 77, >12,125 → 81, >11,023 → 84. Lighter aircraft has a HIGHER VMC.

items.label: Minimum speed, flaps retracted
items.correct: 150 KIAS minimum with flaps retracted. Missing from the gouge.

items.label: Holding speed
items.correct: Not confirmed as a limitation. The icing section of the gouge gives 160 kt recommended (flaps 0°) and 175 kt recommended max, which is closer to published guidance. Treat 150–175 as a rule of thumb, not a limit.

items.label: Engine
items.gouge: Williams International FJ44-4A-QPM, medium bypass ratio

items.label: Normal takeoff thrust
items.src: Card L-14; PTM App B p776

items.label: Automatic Thrust Reserve
items.correct: 3,600 lb. The gouge's '10 min OEI, 5 min AEO' timing was not confirmed in the sources checked.
items.src: Card L-14; PTM App B p776

items.label: N1 limits
items.correct: NTO/ATR/max cont 104.7%; transient high (2 min) 105.7%. Missing entirely.

items.label: N2 limits
items.correct: NTO/ATR/max cont 100.8%; QPM 45.4%; transient high (2 min) 101.5%. Missing entirely — note the QPM N2 figure.

items.label: Oil pressure limits
items.correct: Above 80% N2: 40–120 psi. Below 80% N2: 30–120 psi. Transient high (5 min) 130 psi. Transient low (5 min) 23 psi.

items.label: Oil temperature limits
items.correct: NTO/ATR/max cont 10–135 °C. Starting, ground idle, flight idle -40–135 °C. Transient high (5 min) 149 °C.

items.label: Approved oil brands
items.correct: Mobil Jet II (preferred) and Mobil 254. Not 'Mobile 25' — and the brand is Mobil, not Mobile. A wrong oil spec is a real dispatch problem.
items.src: PTM App B p776; AFM p100

items.label: Oil quantities
items.gouge: Total 5.85 qt, fill 5.65 qt, usable 4.32 qt
items.correct: Confirmed exactly.

items.label: Zero / negative G limit
items.correct: Confirmed. The engine is limited to 10 seconds of continuous flight at zero and/or negative G; oil pressure indicating zero is acceptable during that time.

items.label: Tailwind above 10 kt
items.gouge: Do not exceed 60% N1 until groundspeed exceeds the tailwind

items.label: Engine shutdown cooldown
items.correct: Idle ≥ 2 min with bleed OFF. The AFM states bleed off as part of the limitation, not a recommendation.
items.src: Card L-22; PTM App B p776

items.label: Engine fire protection
items.gouge: 2 × 1.5 lb Halon bottles, either can serve either engine
items.correct: Both left and right fire protection systems must be operative for dispatch.

items.label: Maximum tailwind for start
items.correct: 20 kt estimated steady wind.
items.src: Card L-16; PTM App B p776

items.label: Maximum crosswind for start
items.src: Card L-16; PTM App B p776

items.label: Maximum time to light-off
items.src: Card L-17; PTM App B p776

items.label: Minimum time between starts
items.correct: 60 seconds. Missing from the gouge.

items.label: Minimum oil temp for battery start
items.src: Card L-18; PTM App B p776

items.label: Minimum oil temp, N2 > 80% or QPM
items.src: Card L-19; PTM App B p776

items.label: Starter duty cycle
items.gouge: 50 s on / 60 s off ×2, then 50 s on / 30 min off
items.correct: Attempt 1: 50 s on, 1 min off. Dry motor run: 50 s on, 1 min off. Attempt 2: 50 s on, 30 min off.
items.src: Card L-15; PTM App B p776

items.label: Abort criterion
items.correct: Abort the start if N1 fails to increase by 25% N2.
items.src: Card L-15; PTM App B p776

items.label: Start duty cycle by ITT
items.correct: Not confirmed in the AFM limitations or PTM Appendix B. Treat as unverified.

items.label: Start sequence
items.gouge: DC from BAT/GPU → PCU → DC to AC → SGU spins tower shaft → N2. 7.3% N2 ignition on, 10% N2 fuel introduced, 50.7% N2 start complete
items.correct: The architecture matches the PTM description. The specific percentages (7.3 / 10 / 50.7) were not confirmed against the AFM; card E-17 gives ignition indications at about 10% N2 and START/IGN extinguishing at roughly 45–50% N2, which is consistent but not identical.

items.label: QPM conditions
items.gouge: RH engine. Idle 2 min before and after. No icing (<10 °C + visible moisture). No NAI. Idle only. Exit before LH start. Gen load 250 A. Park brake on. Crew member seated.
items.correct: All correct, but one limit is missing: crosswind/tailwind must be under 20 kt (average). Full AFM set: N2 idle ≥ 2 min, park brake on, TAT > 10 °C, seated with belt fastened, crosswind/tailwind < 20 kt average, left engine off, nacelle anti-ice not operated.

items.label: The 2-minute anchor
items.gouge: Idle 2 min before and after QPM
items.correct: Same 2 minutes governs QPM entry, QPM exit and shutdown cooldown.

items.label: Total capacity
items.correct: 895 US gal / 5,999.8 lb. The gouge's gallons figure is 1 gal low; the pounds figure rounds correctly.

items.label: Fuel balancing thresholds
items.gouge: Begins 220 lb, ceases 440 lb or 4.5 lb
items.correct: Not confirmed in the AFM limitations or PTM Appendix B. 'Ceases 440 lb' is also hard to reconcile with a 330 lb maximum imbalance, and '4.5 lb' looks like a transcription artifact. Do not rely on these numbers — ask your instructor.

items.label: Approved fuel grades
items.gouge: Jet A, Jet A-1, JP-8, TS-I
items.correct: TS-1 with a numeral one, not the letter I.

items.label: Maximum defueling pressure
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Booster pumps and crossfeed valve
items.src: Card L-26; PTM App B p773

items.label: Fuel quantity probes
items.correct: Reads as 12 quantity PROBES ('proves' is a typo). Count not confirmed.

items.label: Battery charging voltage ceiling
items.correct: 29.5 VDC. There is no 32 V limit anywhere in the AFM electrical limitations. The gouge contradicts itself two lines later with the correct '28.0 / 29.5 V' figures. The 29.5 V ceiling is the same for GPU voltage, generator maximum voltage and battery charging — one number, three places.
items.src: Cards L-36, L-37; PTM App B p773

items.label: Generator load limits
items.correct: QPM 250 A, ground idle and above 400 A, flight 400 A, maximum voltage 29.5 VDC.

items.label: Minimum Li-Ion for start
items.correct: State of charge indicators on BOTH batteries green.

items.label: Battery hot warning
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Charge rate before takeoff
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: GPU voltage
items.src: Cards L-34, L-35; PTM App B p773

items.label: GPU load capacity
items.src: Card L-35; PTM App B p773

items.label: GPU minimum volts for start
items.src: Card L-36; PTM App B p773

items.label: GPU volts to charge batteries
items.src: Card L-36; PTM App B p773

items.label: Minimum OAT for GPU start
items.src: Card L-36; PTM App B p773

items.label: Landing flap settings
items.gouge: 15° or 33°; no landing at 0° or 8° unless failed

items.label: Maximum flap in icing
items.correct: Do not extend beyond 15° in icing; do not retract below 8° if ice is present on the surface.
items.src: PTM App B p773; card L-43 family

items.label: Flaps as sole source of power
items.correct: 60 minutes on sole source of power.

items.label: Airbrake positions
items.correct: Position angles not confirmed. What IS confirmed: do not attempt to land with the airbrake extended, and it must be stowed before 50 ft AGL on a stable approach.

items.label: Airbrake with pitch trim inoperative
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Secondary stab trim
items.gouge: Do not use unless primary has failed

items.label: Pitch trim range
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Rudder travel limiter
items.correct: The system is real and UMS-controlled (PTM p295), but these specific angles were not confirmed. Treat as unverified.

items.label: Trim failure landing crosswind
items.correct: Maximum 17 kt crosswind with trim failure.

items.label: Roll assist / MFS / lift dump
items.gouge: Roll assist below 175 KIAS with flaps 8/15/33 and yoke ≥27°; MFS to 35°; lift dump all 4 panels on touchdown
items.correct: Descriptive rather than limiting. Not confirmed against the AFM.

items.label: Gear warning conditions
items.gouge: Flaps > 20°, TLA below approach, speed < 129 KIAS
items.correct: The AFM condition is FLAPS 33°, not 'flaps > 20°'. And it is an OR, not an AND: gear not down and locked with EITHER flaps 33°, OR airspeed below 129 KIAS with at least one throttle of a running engine below approach thrust.

items.label: Gear unsafe warning
items.gouge: 500 ft radio altitude, speed < 178 KIAS ('too low, gear')
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Emergency gear extension
items.correct: See the VLO EGES conflict under Speeds — 160 KIAS per PTM Appendix B, 180 KIAS per the FSI flash card. Fly 160.

items.label: Maximum tire speed
items.src: Card L-29; PTM App B p775

items.label: Nose gear tire type
items.correct: NLG must be dual chine.

items.label: Tire inflation
items.correct: These are the bottom of ranges, not single values. MLG 73.0–76.5 psi, NLG 58.0–61.0 psi. If ambient temp exceeds 59 °F (15 °C), increase per the Ground Servicing Guide.

items.label: Nosewheel steering limits
items.correct: Not confirmed, and the asymmetry is unusual enough to be worth checking with your instructor.

items.label: Brake system pressure
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Minimum brake pressure for takeoff
items.correct: Confirmed — the Park/Emergency accumulator must be recharged to above 2,850 psi before commencing takeoff.

items.label: NO TAKEOFF — accumulator threshold
items.correct: Confirmed, and it is a DIFFERENT threshold from the 2,850 psi recharge target. Both numbers are right — 2,850 is what you recharge to, 2,750 is what trips the warning.

items.label: Brake cooling
items.gouge: 120 min after RTO within 20 kt of Vr, or flaps 0° landing, with heavy braking
items.correct: RTO greater than Vr − 20 kt, on ground 120 minutes; also 0° flaps with heavy braking.

items.label: Anti-skid
items.gouge: Active 3 s after touchdown or 60 kt; de-spin to 10 kt; disabled below 10 kt
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Park/Emergency brake hold time
items.gouge: Provides park brake pressure for minimum 24 hr
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Maximum differential for takeoff and landing
items.correct: Confirmed — the cockpit placard reads 'ENSURE CABIN P MAX. = 0.7 PSID BEFORE LANDING'.

items.label: Normal / placard maximum cabin differential
items.correct: Confirmed. The cockpit placard reads MAXIMUM CABIN DIFF. PRESS. = 8.78 PSID. Do not confuse it with the 9.27 psid structural limit — the gouge correctly lists both.

items.label: CAB LOW differential
items.correct: Confirmed. CAB LOW is a semiautomatic mode that limits maximum differential to 8.83 psi, using destination field elevation as the base reference. It is a selectable mode, not a caution.

items.label: Cabin altitude limiter
items.correct: Confirmed — altitude limiting holds until cabin altitude decreases below 14,500 ft, and DUMP targets 14,500 ft at a rate limited to 35,000 fpm.

items.label: Cabin altitude at 45,000 ft
items.correct: Not confirmed as a limitation.

items.label: Positive pressure relief valve opening
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: CAB ALT CAS trigger
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: FIELD HI threshold
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Emergency ram air
items.gouge: Red handle; usable when cabin pressure is below ram air pressure, cabin altitude 14,500 ft or less
items.correct: Descriptive; not confirmed as a limitation.

items.label: Minimum quantity for dispatch
items.src: Card L-49; PTM App B p775

items.label: Minimum supply above 25,000 ft
items.correct: 10 minutes' duration per occupant for pressurized flight above 25,000 ft MSL.
items.src: Card L-49; PTM App B p775

items.label: FIELD HI mode
items.correct: Multicrew: one pilot continuous use. Single pilot: continuous use.

items.label: Passenger mask auto deployment
items.gouge: Normal 12,850 ft, backup 14,800 ft cabin altitude
items.correct: Confirmed. 12,850 ±150 ft via CPCS in all modes; 14,800 ±500 ft triggered by avionics (ACE) as backup.

items.label: O2 saver
items.gouge: Only in NORMAL mode with saver button; auto-deactivates at cabin altitude 9,000–12,000 ft
items.correct: PTM Appendix B states the O2 saver is NOT for use below 25,000 ft. The gouge's 9,000–12,000 ft auto-deactivation band could not be confirmed and appears to conflict. Check with your instructor before relying on it.

items.label: Crew mask removal temperature
items.correct: Remove temperature 5 °F (-15 °C).

items.label: PRESS TO TEST temperature
items.correct: PRESS TO TEST at or below -12 °C (-10 °F). PBE temperature use at or below -29 °C (-20 °F).

items.label: Overboard discharge indicator
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Ice detectors
items.correct: Confirmed — ice detectors only operate in flight.

items.label: NAI on the ground
items.gouge: OAT below 10 °C plus visible moisture, or ice on the nacelle; not available in QPM
items.src: Card L-45; PTM App B p776

items.label: NAI in the air
items.gouge: TAT below 10 °C plus visible moisture, ice crystals, or ice on airframe

items.label: Do not operate NAI
items.correct: The 10 °C ice line: NAI required below it with moisture, prohibited above it.
items.src: Card L-47; PTM App B p776

items.label: Windshield heat inhibit
items.correct: Windshield heat is inhibited when TAT is ABOVE 10 °C, and on the ground — not 15 °C. The gouge's 15 °C figure does not appear in the limitations.

items.label: Freezing rain / freezing drizzle
items.correct: Must exit immediately. Operation is not allowed at airports reporting freezing rain or drizzle.
items.src: Card L-43; PTM App B p774

items.label: Autopilot in icing
items.gouge: Periodically disengage; AP off in severe icing
items.correct: Periodically disengage to check for abnormal forces. Do not engage in severe icing.
items.src: Card L-44; PTM App B p774

items.label: HSDI / deice boot temperature
items.gouge: -40 °C to +40 °C; visual inspection and functional test if used outside limits
items.correct: The AFM limit is on the cold side: boot inflation at TAT below -40 °C is not recommended unless ice is present, and operation at TAT at or below -40 °C requires a visual and functional check before takeoff. The '+40 °C' half was not confirmed.
items.src: Card L-48; PTM App B p774

items.label: HSDI cycle
items.gouge: 6 s inflation, 54 s deflation (60 s cycle)
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked, though internally consistent.

items.label: Holding in icing on a single bleed source
Wing inspection light
items.gouge: Must be operating for known/forecast icing at night

items.label: Go-around flap retraction in icing
items.correct: Do not retract below 8° if ice is present on the surface.

items.label: Ice shedding procedure
items.gouge: N1/N2 ≥ 85% for 10 s, monitor vibration; OAT 10 °C or less in freezing fog or snow, once every 15 min
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Ice Mode logic
items.gouge: Mode 0 no ice; Mode 1 ice + deice working, latches after 70 s, unlatches TAT 15 °C + 10 min; Mode 2 ice + WAI fail, flaps 15°, override 2→1 never 2→0
items.correct: The mode structure matches the PTM narrative, but the 70 s and 15 °C + 10 min figures were not confirmed. The override rule (2→1, never 2→0) is worth confirming with your instructor.

items.label: SWPS override in icing
items.gouge: Only if no ice on wings
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: AP disengage — all operations except approach
AP disengage — non-precision, circling, visual
items.correct: 400 ft AGL, with airspeed below 150 KIAS and vertical speed below 1,500 ft/min.

items.label: AP disengage — coupled ILS, glideslope under 4.5°
Yaw damper above 30,000 ft
items.gouge: YD required above FL300; do not override
items.correct: Operation above 30,000 ft MSL is prohibited with the yaw damper disengaged.

items.label: Minimum AP engagement altitude
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Minimum YD engagement altitude
items.gouge: 50 ft AGL, gear must be selected up
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Rudder bias — armed
items.gouge: Valid N1s, below 2,500 ft AGL, thrust levers in T/O, yaw damper off
items.correct: Confirmed word for word.
items.src: PTM App B p772; card ACE-23

items.label: Rudder bias — engages / remains active
items.gouge: Significant N1 difference; remains until AP quick disconnect, YD engaged, or asymmetry eliminated
items.correct: Confirmed.

items.label: EDM — armed
items.gouge: Above 30,000 ft MSL and AP engaged
items.src: PTM App B p772; card ACE-16

items.label: EDM — activated
items.correct: The 5-second delay was not confirmed. Note card ACE-16 asks for THREE activation conditions — check that you can name all three, because the gouge only gives two plus the trigger.

items.label: EDM — what the aircraft does
items.gouge: Auto FLC and HDG, sets VMO/MMO, 90° turn, FD to 15,000 ft, AT engaged, throttles idle; at 15,000 ft ALT mode and speed 175
items.correct: Correct, but the turn direction matters: the aircraft turns 90° LEFT. Descends at VMO/MMO to FL150 via FLC, AT engages and sets idle; at 15,000 ft the AP captures ALT and manual speed is set to 175 kt.
items.src: PTM App B p772; card ACE-17

items.label: EDM — cancel
items.correct: AP quick disconnect, manual trim, AP pushbutton on the FD, or TCS — four ways.
items.src: PTM App B p772; card ACE-18

items.label: TCAS RA/TA inhibit
items.gouge: Below 1,100 ft AGL climbing, below 900 ft AGL descending
items.correct: Confirmed exactly — radio altitude below 1,100 ft ascending, below 900 ft descending.
items.src: PTM App B p772; card ACE-37 family

items.label: Tactile feedback
items.gouge: Bank above 51° and overspeed protection; do not override or trim while active
items.correct: The 51° bank figure was not confirmed. Card ACE-21 asks for the TFS engagement bank angle — verify from the card, not from here.

items.label: Auto airbrake deployment
items.correct: Not confirmed. 0.751 is suspiciously precise and may be a transcription of 0.75.

items.label: TOLD
items.correct: TOLD calculations are ADVISORY ONLY and must be cross-referenced. It does not consider terrain — the PIC determines obstacles for climb. Commonly examined.

items.label: Pitch Hold for turbulence
items.correct: Not confirmed as a limitation.

sections.name: Takeoff warning, UMS, water and waste

items.label: NO TAKEOFF triggers
items.gouge: Flaps not 8° or 15°; trim not set; park/emer brake engaged; accumulator below 2,750 psi; thrust levers at MCT over 2 s; rudder gust lock engaged; airbrake not IN
items.correct: Confirmed against the AFM takeoff configuration list, including the 2,750 psi accumulator threshold and the MCT-for-2-seconds condition.

items.label: UMS
items.gouge: Monitors sensors and controls actuators; 4 dual-channel DCPUs; DCPU 1/3 left bus, 2/4 right bus; DCPU 1 powered 60 min on dual engine failure
items.correct: Architecture is consistent with the PTM. The 60-minute figure was not confirmed.

items.label: Lavatory temperature limit
items.gouge: Do not operate on ground or in flight if cabin temp is at or below 2 °C
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Water and waste capacities
items.gouge: 2 gal water tank, 2.3 gal waste tank, immersion heater 32.2–40.5 °C, flush every 15 s
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.

items.label: Flush method by altitude
items.gouge: Above 16,000 ft pressure differential; below 16,000 ft vacuum pump
items.correct: Not confirmed in the sources checked.
